_comment: Accepted findings for check-editor-render-parity.js (CHECK A: editor-canvas desync — a destructured+written attribute never referenced in the preview JSX; CHECK B: invalid CSS keyword passthrough — a SelectControl option value not in the target CSS property's valid keyword set). Same discipline as dead-controls-baseline.json: the guard reports NET-NEW findings only (findings NOT listed here). To accept a finding, add it here with a reason; to fix one, wire the attribute into the preview / correct the SelectControl option, then delete the entry. Empty `accepted` = zero tolerance once/if this is promoted to gate — it ships advisory-only today (2026-08-13), so nothing needs baselining yet; findings are census output, not a blocking backlog.

accepted.reason: Cross-file consumption blind spot (2026-08-13 refinement 2): fieldName's only render.php appearance is as an argument to field_id()/field_label() in includes/forms/field-render-helpers.php, which the detector's single-file dataflow trace can't follow. Verified by hand: field_id() builds the id/for pair (non-paint, id/for/name are already-exempt native functional attrs); field_label() echoes the visible <label> text, but that text comes from the block's OWN 'label' attribute, not fieldName. No visible editor-canvas effect is missing.
